capsules.bug: My sign-up form silently did nothing. No error, no request, no clue.
capsules.cause: A typo in the fetch URL meant the request never left the browser.
capsules.fix: Logged the final URL and the response, added try/catch, and showed a real error message.
capsules.lesson: Never trust the happy path. If a request can fail, prove that it didn't.

capsules.bug: The API worked in Postman but the browser blocked every call.
capsules.cause: The API returned no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header for the site's origin.
capsules.fix: Enabled CORS on the HTTP API and allowed only the deployed Amplify origin.
capsules.lesson: A browser error is often the browser doing its job, not your server failing.

capsules.bug: Pagination skipped the newest item on every page.
capsules.cause: I used a zero-based index against a one-based page calculation.
capsules.fix: Wrote the formula down, added boundary tests for the first and last page.
capsules.lesson: If the math is not obvious, write it on paper before writing it in code.

capsules.bug: A broken config file loaded as an empty object and quietly wiped the page.
capsules.cause: An empty catch block swallowed the JSON parse error.
capsules.fix: Rethrew the error with context and rendered a visible fallback state.
capsules.lesson: A swallowed error is a future outage with better hiding.

capsules.bug: I fixed the CSS, redeployed, and nothing changed on my phone.
capsules.cause: The old stylesheet was cached by the browser and the CDN edge.
capsules.fix: Added a content hash to asset URLs and invalidated the distribution.
capsules.lesson: Before debugging the code, confirm the new code actually arrived.

capsules.bug: The profile page crashed only for accounts with no avatar.
capsules.cause: I read a nested property without checking that the parent existed.
capsules.fix: Used optional chaining plus an explicit placeholder for missing data.
capsules.lesson: Empty, missing, and wrong are three different states. Handle all three.

capsules.bug: The countdown hit zero at the wrong hour for everyone outside my city.
capsules.cause: I mixed a local time string with UTC math.
capsules.fix: Stored everything in UTC and formatted only at display time.
capsules.lesson: Store time in UTC; convert at the edge. Always.

capsules.bug: The build failed on the server but worked perfectly on my laptop.
capsules.cause: A file imported as Style.css while the file was named style.css.
capsules.fix: Renamed imports to match byte-for-byte and added a build check in CI.
capsules.lesson: Your laptop is not the server. CI is the second pair of eyes.

capsules.bug: I nearly pushed an API key inside a config file.
capsules.cause: Hardcoding felt faster than wiring an environment variable.
capsules.fix: Rotated the key, moved it to a local env file, and added .gitignore before committing.
capsules.lesson: The fastest key to leak is the one you typed into the source file.

capsules.bug: The navigation menu fell apart on a narrow phone screen.
capsules.cause: A fixed width and a hover-only menu assumed a desktop mouse.
capsules.fix: Made the nav a real toggle button, used wrapping flex, and tested on a device.
capsules.lesson: Hover is not an interaction model on touch screens.

capsules.bug: The first click after a quiet hour felt broken because nothing happened for two seconds.
capsules.cause: Lambda cold start plus no loading state in the UI.
capsules.fix: Added an optimistic animation and a timeout fallback, and kept the client UX independent.
capsules.lesson: Latency is a design problem, not only an infrastructure problem.

capsules.bug: A clickable div worked with a mouse but could not be reached by keyboard.
capsules.cause: I styled a div to look like a button instead of using a button.
capsules.fix: Replaced it with a real button, added visible focus, and announced results with aria-live.
capsules.lesson: Semantic HTML is the cheapest accessibility feature you will ever ship.

secret.bug: I almost quit the first time a deploy failed three times in a row.
secret.cause: I was treating every failure as proof I could not do it.
secret.fix: I wrote down what each attempt taught me, fixed one thing at a time, and shipped.
secret.lesson: Persistence is a technical skill. The third pull is where the good stuff drops.
